name: Cloud Ginger (XR-1)
summary: A cloud-connected service android with a humanoid torso on a wheeled base and 34 'smart compliant actuators'. CloudMinds put heavy AI compute in the cloud over a 5G link, and demonstrated Ginger threading a needle, opening doors and giving guided tours; it has been deployed as a receptionist and exhibition guide.
notable: Cloud-based 'brain' over 5G rather than heavy onboard compute
